scope: refbrowser.py whole read, blob verified, exact AST selected classes controlled with substituted gc.get_referrers; GUI and real heap traversal not run

control_result.scope: Exact AST classes; get_referrers substituted, no full module import or Tk

findings: Dictionary filtering compares key list with a sample _Node dictionary; a legitimate referrer with those same keys disappears. Reproduced with deterministic get_referrers seam.
Ignore-list membership uses equality, not identity; a user-defined __eq__ can raise and interrupt traversal. Reproduced.
Repeated get_tree retains additional frame references in ignore and does not reset already_included. Observed ignore length 3 then 5 even at depth zero; no long-run memory measurement.
StreamBrowser.print_tree without an explicit tree prints the raw root rather than calling get_tree. Reproduced single ROOT line.
Depth guard tests equality to zero and does not validate negative depth; breadth has no explicit budget. Static finding, no unbounded traversal executed.
Legacy Tkinter and TreeWidget imports gate GUI; no GUI support qualification. No code transferred to production library.
